# TeleportPoint

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Movement.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Movement.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Movement/TeleportPoint.cs#L20)

A marked place the player is allowed to stand, and may choose to. A
[`PlayerRecenter`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/PlayerRecenter) that shows itself: it is the same "put the player here", so it
is the same move, plus the visuals that let the player pick it and the events for arriving.

Being a recenter means a teleport point is also a valid target for a scripted
[`Recenter(Component, bool)`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/IInteractionService#recenter-component-boolean), and that ticking Play On Start is how a
scene says which point the player begins at. Arrival is reported through the inherited
`AfterRecenter`, whichever way the player got here.

```csharp
public class TeleportPoint : PlayerRecenter
```
